user_intent: 期望 湿度 处于 70%
期望 温度 处于18 ℃ 到 28 ℃
期望 亮度 处于 300 lux
空气质量 应 高于 60 Score
如果发生火灾，那么开始报警
如果发生火灾，那么打开逃生通道
人离开时，关闭所有影音、照明、环境控制及厨电类电器
standard_taps: IF miaomiao_air_monitor.reading(RelativeHumidity) > 70 AND aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN turn_on() xiaomi_dehumidifier
IF miaomiao_air_monitor.reading(RelativeHumidity) < 70 AND aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN turn_off() xiaomi_dehumidifier
IF miaomiao_air_monitor.reading(Temperature) > 28 AND aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN turn_cool_on() xiaomi_air_conditioner
IF miaomiao_air_monitor.reading(Temperature) < 18 AND aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN turn_heat_on() xiaomi_air_conditioner
IF wotie_brightness_sensor.brightness() < 300 AND aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN brightness_up() wotie_brightness_sensor
IF wotie_brightness_sensor.brightness() > 300 AND aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN brightness_down() wotie_brightness_sensor
IF miaomiao_air_monitor.reading(air_quality) < 60 AND aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN turn_on() zhimi_air_fresh
IF aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == false THEN turn_off() xiaomi_dehumidifier
IF aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == false THEN turn_off() zhimi_air_fresh
IF aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == false THEN light_off() wotie_brightness_sensor
IF aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == false THEN turn_off() zhimi_fan
